Red Keep Master Plan

The Red Keep

The keep from the infiltration design, fitted inside the game's existing wall. The twin-towered south gate is the main gate; the north gate is the supply gate. Select any room to see what it holds.

Ring 5 · The royal ring

The Holdfast

The Holdfast. A castle within the castle on foundation stone that cannot be dug, ringed by a dry moat lined with iron spikes. One drawbridge on its east face, raised every night from the winch room inside the gate. It sits in the north-west, as far from both gates as the wall allows.

A petitioner's road to the king

The blue line on the plan. Citizens only ever see rings 1 and 2. The king arrives separately, along the red line.

StopWhat happens
1Town roadThe road runs from the town to the south gate, the single public way in. Carts, petitioners and soldiers share it by day.
2Main gatehouseThe portcullis is up by day. Guards in the two gate towers look over everyone who passes beneath the murder holes.
3Outer wardThe crowd gathers in the open courtyard, between the barracks and the Kingsguard hall. The Throne Hall faces them across the ward.
4Waiting galleryPetitioners queue here and gossip until they are called through the side door into the hall.
5Foot of the daisThe petitioner speaks from below the raised dais, with the timber galleries overhead. Then they leave the way they came.

The king never walks the public road. He crosses the Holdfast drawbridge, passes through the inner court and steps onto the dais through the private King's door behind the throne.

Floors by ring

The doc says each ring has its own floor so the player can tell where they are without a map. These tile choices are suggestions.

RingFloor tileSound and light
1 Gate and outer wardCobbles and gravelLoud underfoot; torches and braziers in pools
2 The courtPolished pale flagstones, a carpet runner to the daisEchoing; large lit spaces
3 The working castleOld boards and strawCreaks and rustles; hearth glow, low ceilings
4 The officesDark timber and rugsQuiet; single candles
5 The royal ringOld, thick dark stoneSilent; almost no light
BeneathPacked earth, wet stoneDripping water; only Kael's lantern
